en.heading: Choose a new mentor for m_c
en.info:
If a trainee is 6 moons old and their mentor is changed, they will not be listed as a former apprentice/colt on their old mentor's profile. Trainees without a mentor will have one automatically assigned next moon. A trainee's mentor can have an influence on their trait and skill later in life.
Choose your mentors wisely.

current_mentor.zero: m_c does not have a mentor

en.no_current_apprentices_tooltip: Only show mentors with no current trainees
en.no_former_apprentices_tooltip: Only show mentors who have not had a trainee
